name: Tasajillo
caution: This 'Christmas cactus' has vicious, easily-detached spines; de-spine carefully before eating. Never eat a wild plant on this guide's word alone. Confirm identity against several sources and learn the look-alikes first.

sections.title: Identification
sections.body: A thin, pencil-jointed cholla that lights up with bright red fruit around the holidays, giving it its nickname.

sections.title: Harvesting
sections.body: The fruit is small but persistent through winter. Burn or scrape off every spine before eating.
